planted.description: Discharge rate doubled so vehicles leave twice as fast every green second.
Event active window is inclusive at the end, extending every event by one second.
Swapped NS and EW green times when serializing to JSON.
Off-by-one in fixed-time control delays phase switch by one second.
Wrong recall threshold makes actuated wait-recall trigger far too early.
Missing pedestrian walk extension leaves all-red interval too short when ped pending.
Emergency direction mapping inverted so N/S emergencies preempt E/W and vice versa.
Numerical-precision error requires credit to strictly exceed 1 before discharging a vehicle.
Simulation loop misses final step, running one second fewer than requested.
Yellow phase lasts one second too long due to wrong comparison operator.
